tableDescription: Accounts table. Real account: `is_test = false AND deleted_at IS NULL`. Never count test or deleted accounts in any business metric. Paying customer in a period: real account with at least one paid invoice (`status = 'paid'`) whose `paid_at` is in the period. ARPA (Average revenue per paying customer): Net revenue in the period divided by paying customers in the period. Churned account: real account with at least one churn subscription (`status = 'canceled' AND cancel_reason IN ('voluntary', 'payment_failed')`) canceled on or before the date. Date windows are half-open: `>= start AND < next_period_start` (e.g., Q3 2026: `>= '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND < '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'`). Never use BETWEEN with end dates.

columnDescriptions.name: Account business or company name.
columnDescriptions.plan: DEPRECATED signup plan name. NEVER use for reporting; use `plan_tier` instead.
columnDescriptions.plan_tier: Current plan tier: 'starter', 'pro', 'enterprise'. Always use `plan_tier` for current plan reporting, never `plan`.
columnDescriptions.is_test: Test account flag. Real accounts MUST have `is_test = false`.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Account creation timestamp. Half-open windows: `>= start AND < next_period_start`.
columnDescriptions.deleted_at: Account deletion timestamp. Real accounts MUST have `deleted_at IS NULL`.

tableDescription: User event log. Active user in a period: a real user (`users.deleted_at IS NULL` on a real account where `accounts.is_test = false AND accounts.deleted_at IS NULL`) with at least one event in `events` where `occurred_at >= start AND occurred_at < next_period_start`. Half-open date windows required; never use BETWEEN with end date.

columnDescriptions.account_id: Account ID associated with the event.
columnDescriptions.user_id: User ID who performed the event.
columnDescriptions.occurred_at: Timestamp when the event occurred. Use half-open window: `occurred_at >= start AND occurred_at < next_period_start`.

tableDescription: Foreign exchange conversion rates to USD. Join on currency to convert money amounts to USD: `amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx_rates.usd_per_unit`.

columnDescriptions.usd_per_unit: Exchange rate: multiply foreign currency amount by `usd_per_unit` to get USD equivalent.

tableDescription: Invoices for subscriptions. Gross revenue for a period: `SUM(amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx_rates.usd_per_unit)` for paid invoices (`status = 'paid'`) with `paid_at >= start AND paid_at < next_period_start` on real accounts (`accounts.is_test = false AND accounts.deleted_at IS NULL`). Net revenue = Gross revenue minus Refunds for the period (cash basis). Compute gross and refunds as two separate subqueries (invoices filtered on `paid_at`, refunds filtered on `created_at`), then subtract; do not join invoices to refunds in one filtered query.

columnDescriptions.subscription_id: Subscription ID associated with this invoice.
columnDescriptions.account_id: Account ID. Real accounts only: `accounts.is_test = false AND accounts.deleted_at IS NULL`.
columnDescriptions.amount_cents: Invoice amount in cents. USD value = `amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx_rates.usd_per_unit`. Must divide as numeric (`::numeric / 100`).
columnDescriptions.currency: Currency of invoice ('USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Join to `fx_rates.currency` for conversion.
columnDescriptions.paid_at: Timestamp invoice was paid. Revenue period filtering uses `paid_at` with half-open window: `paid_at >= start AND paid_at < next_period_start`.

tableDescription: Subscriptions. Active subscription: `status = 'active'` on a real account (`accounts.is_test = false AND accounts.deleted_at IS NULL`). `trialing` and `past_due` are separate and NOT active. Churn: `status = 'canceled' AND cancel_reason IN ('voluntary', 'payment_failed')` with `canceled_at >= start AND canceled_at < next_period_start` on a real account. `cancel_reason = 'upgrade'` is NOT churn.

columnDescriptions.account_id: Account ID. Real accounts only (`is_test = false AND deleted_at IS NULL`).
columnDescriptions.status: Subscription status: 'active', 'trialing', 'past_due', 'canceled'. Only 'active' counts as active.
columnDescriptions.canceled_at: Timestamp subscription was canceled. Churn uses `canceled_at >= start AND canceled_at < next_period_start`.
columnDescriptions.cancel_reason: Reason for cancellation: 'voluntary', 'payment_failed', 'upgrade'. Only 'voluntary' and 'payment_failed' count as churn. 'upgrade' is NOT churn.

tableDescription: Refunds for invoices. A refund belongs to an invoice via `refunds.invoice_id = invoices.id`. Refunds for a period = `SUM(refunds.amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx_rates.usd_per_unit)` for refunds with `created_at >= start AND created_at < next_period_start` on real accounts, using the currency of the associated invoice. In net revenue calculations, compute gross and refunds as two separate subqueries (invoices filtered on `paid_at`, refunds filtered on `created_at`), then subtract.

columnDescriptions.amount_cents: Refund amount in cents. USD value = `refunds.amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx_rates.usd_per_unit` using associated `invoices.currency`. Must divide as numeric (`::numeric / 100`).
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp refund was created. Period filtering uses `created_at >= start AND created_at < next_period_start`.

tableDescription: Users table. Real user: `users.deleted_at IS NULL` and belongs to a real account (`accounts.is_test = false AND accounts.deleted_at IS NULL`). Active user in a period: real user with at least one event in `events` during the period.

columnDescriptions.account_id: Account ID user belongs to. Must join to `accounts` to verify real account.
columnDescriptions.deleted_at: Timestamp user was deleted. Real users must have `deleted_at IS NULL`.
